Alex K: Quick heads-up— found ~0.5% of billing events missing provenance_id for chunked requests when prefixes are hydrated from KV. Repro in staging.
Maria T: Only chunked+KV path? Can you paste the log line?
Alex K: Yep only chunked+kv-hit. Log snippet:
`INFO finalizer: event {request_id: "r42", provenance_id: null, source: "kv-prefix-cache"}`
Dan P: Theory: KV hydrate returns bytes but doesn't copy provenance header into per-chunk envelope. Short-term: synth a provenance_id at hydrate and mark confidence="synthetic" + provenance_origin="kv-hydrate".
Sophie L: Fine for continuity but audits must treat synthetic as low-confidence. We need metrics and a playbook.
Maria T: I can patch the KV shim to inject provenance_id if missing. Will add unit test for chunk replay.
Alex K: Also add provenance_origins array so downstream prefer native provenance when present. Size impact ~+100-150 bytes/event but cheaper than full backfill.
Dan P: Long-term: RFC to require provenance header at ingest, runtime enforcement, and a compact provenance registry (id->fingerprint).
Sophie L: Ops: add alert finalizer.null_provenance_rate >0.1% over 1h and metric finalizer.synthetic_provenance_rate. Create playbook to sample traces and run a stitch job.
IngestBot: Alert created: metric(finalizer.null_provenance_rate)=0.52% at 2026-03-21T14:02:13Z; ticket ING-3982
Maria T: Action items: (1) Hotfix KV shim -> deploy staging (Maria), (2) RFC + recon plan (Alex), (3) registry & backfill sketch (Dan), (4) dashboards + playbook (Sophie).
Alex K: I'll draft RFC today and include storage sizing for registry. Target: hotfix in staging within 48h, canary to prod after validation.
Dan P: For backfill: best-effort join on request fingerprint + tokenizer offsets + model telemetry to estimate token attribution and mark as estimated in exports.
Sophie L: Also run a sampling job first week post-rollout to validate synthetic vs native attribution quality.
Maria T: Opening PR shortly. Ping me for test review.
Alex K: Thanks all. React with :thumbsup: if this summary looks right.
